query:
SELECT 
  ar.id,
  ar.wow_report_status,
  ar.wow_report_error,
  JSON_KEYS(ar.wow_report_json) as section_keys,
  LENGTH(ar.wow_report_json) as json_length
FROM analysis_reports ar
JOIN client_profiles cp ON ar.client_profile_id = cp.id
JOIN users u ON cp.user_id = u.id
WHERE u.email LIKE '%amanda%' OR u.name LIKE '%Amanda%' OR u.name LIKE '%Lord%'
LIMIT 5;
